-- Vérifier le vrai ID de la molécule dominante de Rose de Damas
SELECT gvml.molecule_id, gvml.link_type, gvml.percentage, m.name 
FROM ghost_variety_molecule_links gvml 
JOIN molecules m ON gvml.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE gvml.ghost_variety_id = 1 AND gvml.link_type = 'dominant'
LIMIT 5;

-- Vérifier les données molecule_origins (test attend quoi ?)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, MIN(id) as min_id, MAX(id) as max_id FROM molecule_origins;

-- Vérifier IFRA restrictions disponibles (quelles molécules ont des restrictions ?)
SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ifra_restrictions GROUP BY molecule_id LIMIT 5;
